```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent "Entity value with <tag>">
  <!ENTITY % param "<!ENTITY ent2 'Parameter entity value'>">
  %param;
]>
<?target data="processing instruction"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.org/ns" xmlns:sub="http://example.org/sub">
  <!-- Comment containing special characters: <>&'" -->
  <sub:child id="1">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block containing <tags>, &entities; and -- comments --
    ]]>
  </sub:child>
  <child>&ent; and &ent2;</child>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE doc [
  <!ELEMENT doc (section+)>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ext SYSTEM "http://example.org/dtd">
  %ext;
  <!ENTITY base "Base Entity">
  <!ENTITY derived "&base; extended">
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="style.xsl"?>
<doc xmlns="http://xml.org/base" xmlns:x="http://xml.org/ext">
  <!-- First comment block -->
  <x:section id="s1">
    <![CDATA[
      Nesting CDATA inside namespace element
    ]]>
  </x:section>
  <section>&derived;</section>
  <!-- Second comment block -->
</doc>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item+)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY book "XML Guide">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY logo SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
]>
<?pi-target data="value" action="test"?>
<catalog xmlns="http://catalog.org" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" xlink:type="extended">
  <!-- Outer comment -->
  <item xlink:type="locator" xlink:href="#item1">
    <![CDATA[
      Unparsed text chunk with <markup> and &
    ]]>
  </item>
  <item>&book;</item>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (record)*>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY e1 "Value One">
  <!ENTITY e2 "Value Two &e1;">
  <!ENTITY % p1 "<!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA | sub)*>">
  %p1;
]>
<?xml-debug level="high" mode="verbose"?>
<archive xmlns="http://archive.org/ns" xmlns:meta="http://archive.org/meta">
  <!-- Archive metadata comment -->
  <meta:info>
    <![CDATA[
      <meta:data>Raw CDATA with entity reference &e2;</meta:data>
    ]]>
  </meta:info>
  <record>&e2;</record>
</archive>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE notes [
  <!ELEMENT notes (note*)>
  <!ELEMENT note (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY greeting "Hello World">
  <!ENTITY % dtd-macro "<!ENTITY nested '&greeting; - Nested'>">
  %dtd-macro;
]>
<?xml-client action="refresh" interval="30"?>
<notes xmlns="http://notes.org" xmlns:custom="http://notes.org/custom">
  <!-- Top comment outlining notes -->
  <custom:note priority="high">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block with some text & more text.
    ]]>
  </custom:note>
  <note>&nested;</note>
</notes>
```
